posts.text: My ADHD brain doesn’t run on deadlines. It runs on adrenaline.
ADHD hack: rename your tasks as quests. Suddenly, you’re the hero again.

Your ADHD symptoms get loud again right around perimenopause and nobody warned you. Estrogen helps regulate dopamine, so when it starts dropping, your focus, memory, and mood can feel like they're malfunctioning overnight. It's not you falling apart, it's chemistry shifting under you. The one thing that actually helps: stop assuming you're suddenly broken and start tracking what changed and when. Write down the week things got harder. Patterns are easier to manage than mysteries.
ADHD recovery isn’t about perfection — it’s about permission to rest.
Reminder: I’ll literally stop and ask, “Wait… am I actually in trouble or is this my ADHD brain?”
